model: The song I'd like to talk about is Viva la Vida by Coldplay. It came out in 2008, but I only discovered it in my final year of university, when a friend played it during a road trip to Vung Tau. It has a really catchy tune, with those violins at the start, and I had it on repeat for pretty much the whole year. That period was a turning point for me, because I was finishing my degree and applying for jobs, and I felt like I was at a crossroads. I didn't know whether to stay in my hometown or move to Ho Chi Minh City. The song is about a king who loses his power, which arguably has nothing to do with my situation, but to some extent the lyrics resonated with me, because they're about change and looking back on the past. Whenever I hear it now, it takes me back to those late nights studying in the library and the long talks with my friends about the future. It definitely brings back memories, and it gives me a bittersweet feeling. I tend to feel nostalgic, because most of those friends have moved abroad now, but I also feel proud of how far I've come since then. It seems to me that music has a special way of storing memories, and this song is probably the clearest example for me.
